name: collapse_polymorphic
recovery_queries: SELECT post_id, body FROM comments WHERE post_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT photo_id, body FROM comments WHERE photo_id IS NOT NULL
instruction:
Comments attach to either a post or a photo through a polymorphic pair of columns, (parent_type, parent_id). Replace it with real, typed columns.

Requirements:
  1. `comments` must have `post_id` and `photo_id`, with exactly one of them non-null per row.
  2. Every comment must still point at the same parent it pointed at before.
  3. `parent_type` and `parent_id` must be gone when you are done.
  4. `app.comment_parent(conn, comment_id)` must return ('post', id) or ('photo', id).

Nothing else in the database records which parent a comment belonged to.

Run `run_tests` to check your work, then `submit`. There is no backup: data you delete is gone unless you have an undo left.
